images.prompt: 19th-century brigantine, 1872, grey North Atlantic: a two-masted merchant brigantine drifting alone on a heavy grey swell under an overcast sky, some sails set and some torn and flapping loose, the deck completely empty, the ship's wheel unattended. The ship sits in the lower-middle of the frame, open grey sky above.

19th-century brigantine, 1872, grey North Atlantic: a small wooden rowing boat with three tiny faceless silhouette sailors seen from far behind, rowing across the swell toward a silent drifting brigantine that looms above them, nobody visible on its deck.

19th-century brigantine, 1872, grey North Atlantic: inside a small dim ship's cabin lit by grey daylight from a porthole: neatly folded clothes on a bunk, several wooden sea chests with lids open, packed full of folded clothes, oil-skin coats on hooks, everything tidy and untouched.

19th-century brigantine, 1872, grey North Atlantic: close view of an open square cargo hatch on a wet wooden deck, the heavy hatch cover lying beside it, below in the darkness dark water sloshing around stacked wooden barrels.

19th-century brigantine, 1872, grey North Atlantic: on wet deck planks beside a wooden bilge-pump box, the pump has been taken apart: its round wooden pipe sections, leather valve discs and a curved pump handle laid neatly in a row, and next to them a long thin straight measuring rod marked with notches for sounding water depth, cold grey light, sea spray. Plain maintenance tools only.

19th-century brigantine, 1872, grey North Atlantic: view along the empty deck of the brigantine, the ship floating upright and steady on a calm grey sea; in the middle, two empty wooden chocks where the ship's only lifeboat should rest, loose cut lashing ropes lying on the planks.

19th-century brigantine, 1872, grey North Atlantic: a wooden navigation shelf above a chart table in a ship's cabin, the brass brackets and an open fitted wooden case are empty, faint dust outlines where a sextant and a chronometer used to sit, an empty open drawer.

19th-century brigantine, 1872, grey North Atlantic: seen from the deck of a sailing ship at dawn, the dark silhouette of a volcanic island on the horizon across a calm sea, soft cold amber light; on a wooden ledge in the foreground a small slate board with faint chalk lines, blurred and unreadable.

19th-century brigantine, 1872, grey North Atlantic: stormy dusk at sea: a single faceless silhouette of a ship's captain seen from behind, holding a lantern over an open cargo hatch and peering down into the dark hold, rain and wind, the only light is the lantern.

19th-century brigantine, 1872, grey North Atlantic: early morning, calm sea: a small rowing boat carrying several tiny faceless silhouettes, tied by one long rope to the stern of the brigantine and trailing behind it, a dark island silhouette far on the horizon. Seen from far away.

19th-century brigantine, 1872, grey North Atlantic: the moment a long tow rope snaps: the brigantine's sails suddenly fill with wind and the ship surges away, the broken rope end whipping in the air, a small rowing boat with tiny faceless silhouettes left falling behind on the swell. Seen from far away, dramatic grey light.

19th-century brigantine, 1872, grey North Atlantic: night: the empty brigantine sailing alone across a vast dark sea under a thin moon, sails half set, not a single light on board, no one on deck, endless empty water all around.

The owl Boogi sitting at a cozy archivist's wooden desk at night beside its small amber lantern, an open old logbook in front of it and a pinned paper note with a simple drawing of a cut rope end, a ship-in-a-bottle on the shelf behind, warm single light, dark navy room.

youtube.title: 6개월 치 식량을 두고, 멀쩡한 배를 떠난 10명
youtube.summary: 1872년 12월 대서양. 키 잡는 사람 없이 떠가던 배에 건너가 보니, 옷도 식량도 화물도 그대로인데 사람 10명과 구명보트만 없었습니다. 마지막 기록엔 '섬이 보인다'는 한 줄.
youtube.pinned: 섬이 10km 앞이었다면, 당신은 그 보트에 탔을까요?

sources: 출처: Smithsonian Magazine(2007·2024), American Heritage 'The Mystery of the Mary Celeste', History.com
threads: 1872년 대서양 얘기 하나 해줄게. 6개월 치 식량을 그대로 두고, 멀쩡한 배에서 10명이 작은 보트로 떠났어.
키 잡는 사람도 없이 떠가던 배를 지나던 배 선원들이 발견했어. 건너가 보니 옷도 짐 상자도 술통 화물도 그대로였대.
없어진 건 구명보트랑 항해 도구, 배 서류뿐. 화물칸엔 물이 1m쯤 차 있었고 펌프 하나는 뜯겨 있었어. 근데 배는 멀쩡히 떠 있었지.
마지막 기록은 '섬이 10km 앞에 보인다'. 가장 유력한 설명은, 잠깐 피하려고 보트를 밧줄로 묶었는데 그 밧줄이 끊어졌다는 거야. 빈 배는 혼자 9일 동안 700km를 갔고, 10명은 끝내 발견되지 않았어.
